# StylizedTrees third-party assets

Source: https://github.com/mozankatip/StylizedTrees
Author: Mert Ozan Katipoglu
License: MIT (see LICENSE.txt)

Includes three tree models with LOD0/1/2, tree prefabs and color variants, wind particle prefabs, materials, textures, and the Leaves Shader Graph. Original .meta files are preserved to retain asset references.

Use: drag a prefab from Prefabs/Trees into a URP scene. Wind particles are optional.

Imported from the local StylizedTrees-main working copy, previously opened with Unity 6000.6.9f1. The original upstream project used Unity 2021.3.28f1. Compatibility with this team project on 6000.3.25f1 has not yet been verified in the Editor.

The upstream demo scene, terrain, render pipeline settings, Packages and ProjectSettings are deliberately excluded. Existing team rendering settings are retained.

These are third-party visual assets and a baseline wind shader. The project-specific replayable wind field and graphics experiments should be implemented separately.
